process_roboflow_result: process a roboflow prediction result dict into numpy arrays of bounding boxes, masks, and class data
extract_ultralytics_masks: extract and resize segmentation masks from ultralytics YOLOv8 inference results to original image shape
merge_data: merge data payloads from a list of detection dictionaries by concatenating numpy arrays and lists
merge_metadata: merge metadata dictionaries from multiple detections, raising on conflicting values for the same key
get_data_item: retrieve a subset of a detection data dictionary by integer index, slice, list, or boolean mask
